standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness at a prime descends along a flat local base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-base-change-flat-up-down}, cited at proof lines 4135-4137
standard_prerequisites.use: Carries flatness of the localised base changed module back to the localisation of the module over the base.

standard_prerequisites.name: Surjectivity of the induced map on the closed sets defined by the ideals
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: assumption (1) of the lemma, used at proof lines 4125-4127
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the prime of the base change lying over the given prime.

core_obligations: Choose a prime of the algebra containing the image of the ideal and the corresponding prime of the base (proof lines 4123-4126).
Use surjectivity on the closed sets to find a prime of the base change above it with flat local map (proof lines 4126-4128).
Choose a prime of the tensor product over both and identify the localised tensor product with a localisation of the tensor product of the local rings (proof lines 4129-4133).
Apply the flat base change criterion to conclude (proof lines 4134-4140).
proof_roadmap: Set up the primes and the flat local map (proof lines 4123-4128).
Move to the tensor product (proof lines 4129-4133).
difficulty_reason: The lemma descends the condition that a module is flat over the base at all primes containing the image of an ideal, along a base change whose induced map on the closed sets defined by the ideals is surjective and which is flat at the relevant primes. The proof is a localisation chase of the same shape as its siblings: given a prime of the algebra over the ideal, surjectivity on the closed sets supplies a prime of the base change above it together with a flat local map, a prime of the tensor product is chosen over both, the localised tensor product is identified with a localisation of the tensor product of the local rings, and flatness of the base changed module there is pulled back to flatness over the source local ring by the flat base change criterion.
